description: Source file for CartRepository class which manages shopping cart state, synchronization with backend API, coupon application, and related cart operations in an Android Kotlin project.

classes.name: CartRepository
classes.description: Manages cart state, synchronization with backend, coupon logic, and cart operations.

methods.name: setActiveEmail
methods.description: Sets or clears the user's email, manages migration and fetching cart data from backend.

methods.name: ensureCartLoaded
methods.description: Ensures the cart is loaded from backend at least once for the current user.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a product with specified quantity to the cart and syncs with backend.

methods.name: updateQty
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific product in the cart and syncs with backend.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart and updates backend.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart and updates backend.

methods.name: addSavedCoupon
methods.description: Saves a coupon code locally for future use.

methods.name: removeSavedCoupon
methods.description: Removes a coupon code from local saved coupons.

methods.name: clearSavedCoupons
methods.description: Clears all locally saved coupon codes.

methods.name: isCouponSaved
methods.description: Checks if a coupon code is in the saved list.

methods.name: applyCoupon
methods.description: Attempts to apply a coupon code, with validation and backend interaction.

methods.name: removeCoupon
methods.description: Removes a coupon from cart and backend.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Computes and returns current cart summary (total items, subtotal).

methods.name: discountedTotals
methods.description: Returns cart totals including discount, from local state.

methods.name: groupedByCategory
methods.description: Groups cart items by category, sorted by category name.
